description: Unit tests for the ParsedCookie class in the net namespace, testing cookie parsing, validation, attribute handling, and size constraints.

classes.name: ParsedCookie
classes.description: Class representing a parsed HTTP cookie with methods for validation, attribute management, and serialization.

methods.name: TestBasic
methods.description: Tests basic parsing and attribute extraction from cookie strings.

methods.name: TestEmpty
methods.description: Tests handling of empty or whitespace-only cookie strings.

methods.name: TestSetEmptyNameValue
methods.description: Tests setting empty name and value attributes.

methods.name: ParseValueStrings
methods.description: Tests parsing of various value strings, including invalid and whitespace cases.

methods.name: TestQuoted
methods.description: Tests handling of quoted cookie values.

methods.name: TestNameless
methods.description: Tests cookies with no name attribute.

methods.name: TestAttributeCase
methods.description: Tests case-insensitivity of attribute parsing.

methods.name: TestDoubleQuotedNameless
methods.description: Tests cookies with double-quoted nameless values.

methods.name: QuoteOffTheEnd
methods.description: Tests handling of incomplete quoted values.

methods.name: MissingName
methods.description: Tests cookies with missing name attribute.

methods.name: MissingValue
methods.description: Tests cookies with missing value attribute.

methods.name: Whitespace
methods.description: Tests parsing of cookie strings with whitespace and multiple attributes.

methods.name: MultipleEquals
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple '=' characters in cookie values.

methods.name: QuotedTrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Tests handling of quoted values with trailing whitespace.

methods.name: TrailingWhitespace
methods.description: Tests handling of trailing whitespace in cookie values.

methods.name: LotsOfPairs
methods.description: Tests parsing of cookies with many attribute pairs.

methods.name: EnforceSizeConstraints
methods.description: Tests enforcement of maximum size constraints on cookie name, value, and attributes.

methods.name: EmbeddedTerminator
methods.description: Tests handling of embedded null, carriage return, and newline characters.

methods.name: ParseTokensAndValues
methods.description: Tests parsing of token and value strings with special characters.

methods.name: SerializeCookieLine
methods.description: Tests serialization of cookies into cookie line format.

methods.name: SetNameAndValue
methods.description: Tests setting name and value attributes with various inputs.

methods.name: SetAttributes
methods.description: Tests setting various cookie attributes and their serialization.

methods.name: EmptyDomainAttributeValid
methods.description: Tests that an empty domain attribute is considered valid.

methods.name: MultipleDomainAttributes
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple domain attributes, including empty values.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Tests setting of the priority attribute with various case-insensitive inputs.

methods.name: SetSameSite
methods.description: Tests setting of the SameSite attribute with various case-insensitive inputs.

methods.name: CookieSameSiteStringEnum
methods.description: Tests mapping of SameSite string values to enum and vice versa.

methods.name: SettersInputValidation
methods.description: Tests validation of inputs to attribute setters.

methods.name: ToCookieLineSpecialTokens
methods.description: Tests handling of special tokens like 'secure', 'httponly', and 'sameparty' in cookie line output.

methods.name: SameSiteValues
methods.description: Tests parsing of various samesite attribute values.

methods.name: InvalidNonAlphanumericChars
methods.description: Tests invalid characters in cookie name and value, expecting invalid parsing.

methods.name: ValidNonAlphanumericChars
methods.description: Tests valid non-ASCII characters in cookie name and value.

methods.name: TruncatingCharInCookieLine
methods.description: Tests detection of control characters that truncate cookie strings.

methods.name: HtabInNameOrValue
methods.description: Tests detection of internal horizontal tab characters in name or value.
